title: Question 26
passage:
I’m setting up in Room Three, but the key they gave me is for Room Two.
A. Room Three is already unlocked. You can go straight in. B. The key for Room Two goes back at the end of the day. C. We usually put the chairs in rows before the meeting.
passageZh:
我要在三號會議室做準備，但他們給我的是二號會議室的鑰匙。
A. 三號會議室沒上鎖，你可以直接進去。 B. 二號會議室的鑰匙今天結束前要還。 C. 我們通常會在開會前把椅子排成一列列的。
